statements.statement: For an induced m-vertex subgraph H of a (99,14,1,2) graph, if K=H+4I is positive definite, every occurring exterior type t has t^T K^-1 t<=4; any two distinct exterior vertices with types t,u and adjacency a satisfy (a-t^T K^-1 u)^2<=(4-t^T K^-1 t)(4-u^T K^-1 u). The whole Schur complement is positive semidefinite of rank55-m.

For the exact linear selected-triangle edge union on17 points with selected degrees3 at two adjacent centers and2 elsewhere, with each edge already having one internal common neighbor, K=H+4I is positive definite. Every independent binary type of size<=7 containing at most one center obeys q(t)<=(|t|+number_of_centers_in_t)/2<=4, strictly in the first inequality for nonempty t; hence the single-type lower-Gram Schur inequality excludes none of these types.
